newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chubais sees huge growth in Russian stockmarket.
newsitem.headline: Chubais sees huge growth in Russian stockmarket.

text.p: The market capitalisation of the Russian equities market could grow to hundreds of billions of dollars as recent decisions clarifying regulation of the securities markets attract new company share issues and new investment, First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Friday.
Russian market capitalisation has nearly doubled since the beginning of the year to $90 billion currently. Chubais gave no timeframe for his forecast.
"The growth of the Russian stockmarket is possible, not by percentage points, not by a number of times, but tens of times," Chubais told a news conference.
"We are talking about hundreds of billions of dollars of potential growth of the volume of the Russian equities market," he said.

The authorities have agreed to allow banks to operate on securities markets with existing licences until January 1 next year instead of the previous limit of October 1 this year. the new agreements abandon the principle of regulating the government securities and equities markets separately, he said.
These decisions remove major elements of uncertainty from the markets, he said.
